From fa92a77b0ed4d5f11a71665a232ac5a54a4b055d Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Dudu Lu <phx0fer@gmail.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 16:53:49 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] macvlan: fix macvlan_get_size() not reserving space for
 IFLA_MACVLAN_BC_CUTOFF

macvlan_get_size() does not account for IFLA_MACVLAN_BC_CUTOFF, but
macvlan_fill_info() conditionally includes it when port->bc_cutoff != 1.
This causes nla_put_s32() to fail with -EMSGSIZE when the netlink skb
runs out of space, triggering a WARN_ON in rtnetlink and preventing the
interface from being dumped.

The bug can be reproduced with:

  ip link add macvlan0 link eth0 type macvlan mode bridge
  ip link set macvlan0 type macvlan bc_cutoff 0
  ip -d link show macvlan0   # fails with -EMSGSIZE

The bc_cutoff feature was added in commit 954d1fa1ac93 ("macvlan: Add
netlink attribute for broadcast cutoff"), which added the nla_put_s32()
call in macvlan_fill_info() but missed adding the corresponding
nla_total_size(4) in macvlan_get_size(). A follow-up commit
55cef78c244d ("macvlan: add forgotten nla_policy for
IFLA_MACVLAN_BC_CUTOFF") fixed the missing nla_policy entry but still
did not fix the size calculation.

Fixes: 954d1fa1ac93 ("macvlan: Add netlink attribute for broadcast cutoff")
Signed-off-by: Dudu Lu <phx0fer@gmail.com>
Reviewed-by: Vadim Fedorenko <vadim.fedorenko@linux.dev>
Reviewed-by: Eric Dumazet <edumazet@google.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260413085349.73977-1-phx0fer@gmail.com
Signed-off-by: Paolo Abeni <pabeni@redhat.com>

diff --git a/drivers/net/macvlan.c b/drivers/net/macvlan.c
index 9f90c598649d..c40fa331836b 100644
--- a/drivers/net/macvlan.c
+++ b/drivers/net/macvlan.c
@@ -1689,6 +1689,7 @@ static size_t macvlan_get_size(const struct net_device *dev)
 		+ macvlan_get_size_mac(vlan) /* IFLA_MACVLAN_MACADDR */
 		+ nla_total_size(4) /* IFLA_MACVLAN_BC_QUEUE_LEN */
 		+ nla_total_size(4) /* IFLA_MACVLAN_BC_QUEUE_LEN_USED */
+		+ nla_total_size(4) /* IFLA_MACVLAN_BC_CUTOFF */
 		);
 }
 
-- 
2.34.1

The patch modifies a single file, `drivers/net/macvlan.c`, to fix a netlink buffer size miscalculation.

**Modifications in `drivers/net/macvlan.c`**  
- In the `macvlan_get_size()` function, added `nla_total_size(4)` for the `IFLA_MACVLAN_BC_CUTOFF` attribute to the returned total size.

**Relationship between modifications**  
The change ensures that the netlink message size computed by `macvlan_get_size()` accounts for the `IFLA_MACVLAN_BC_CUTOFF` attribute (a 4-byte signed integer). Previously, `macvlan_fill_info()` conditionally added this attribute (when `port->bc_cutoff != 1`), but its space was not reserved, causing `nla_put_s32()` to fail with `-EMSGSIZE` and triggering a `WARN_ON` in `rtnetlink`. By including the proper `nla_total_size(4)` in the size calculation, the buffer is now allocated with enough room for the attribute, preventing the failure and allowing correct interface dumping via `ip -d link show`.

The bug can be reproduced with:

  ip link add macvlan0 link eth0 type macvlan mode bridge
  ip link set macvlan0 type macvlan bc_cutoff 0
  ip -d link show macvlan0   # fails with -EMSGSIZE

The bc_cutoff feature was added in commit 954d1fa1ac93 ("macvlan: Add

Reviewed-by: Vadim Fedorenko <vadim.fedorenko@linux.dev>
Reviewed-by: Eric Dumazet <edumazet@google.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260413085349.73977-1-phx0fer@gmail.com
Signed-off-by: Paolo Abeni <pabeni@redhat.com>

Here is the root cause:
The `macvlan_get_size()` function did not account for the `IFLA_MACVLAN_BC_CUTOFF` attribute when calculating the required netlink message buffer size, even though `macvlan_fill_info()` conditionally adds this attribute (when `port->bc_cutoff != 1`). This mismatch caused `nla_put_s32()` to fail with `-EMSGSIZE` when the buffer was too small, triggering a WARN_ON in rtnetlink and preventing interface dump.

Here is the patch:
 
 static size_t macvlan_get_size(const struct net_device *dev)
 {
 	struct macvlan_dev *vlan = netdev_priv(dev);
 
 	return (0
 		+ nla_total_size(4) /* IFLA_MACVLAN_MODE */
 		+ nla_total_size(2) /* IFLA_MACVLAN_FLAGS */
 		+ nla_total_size(4) /* IFLA_MACVLAN_MACADDR_COUNT */
 		+ macvlan_get_size_mac(vlan) /* IFLA_MACVLAN_MACADDR */
 		+ nla_total_size(4) /* IFLA_MACVLAN_BC_QUEUE_LEN */
 		+ nla_total_size(4) /* IFLA_MACVLAN_BC_QUEUE_LEN_USED */
+		+ nla_total_size(4) /* IFLA_MACVLAN_BC_CUTOFF */
 		);
 }
